POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

2. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

6. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

8. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.

9. When learning General workshop rules and regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations.

10. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.

11. When learning Blending of lines and curves, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending of lines and curves.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Blending of lines and curves.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Engine components and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution of motor vehicles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Power Mechanics workshop layout and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

3. C — Information and Communication Technology

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

5. B — CPU

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.

7. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending of lines and curves.

12. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Engine components; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Evolution of motor vehicles; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Power Mechanics workshop layout; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
